title: Daily S1/R1 × H1 rejection — time-of-day and weekday heterogeneity

dataset.analysis_timeframe: Daily classic pivots / H1 forward response
dataset.timezone: UTC source with DST-safe local session mapping

hypotheses.market_question: Does the observable Daily S1/R1 + strong directional H1 rejection signal have materially different forward reversal behavior depending on major FX session phase and day of week?
hypotheses.null: Session Hour 1/2/3 and weekday do not add stable directional forward-reversal information to the S1/R1 strong-wick signal beyond non-transition time and matched controls.
hypotheses.alternative: At least one frozen session phase produces stable incremental directional forward-reversal information, while weekday may show stable heterogeneity.
hypotheses.mechanism: If price and economically important market time interact, rejection at first-order daily pivots may have different forward behavior around session liquidity transitions than at otherwise comparable hours.

method.primary_endpoint: direction-adjusted next-contiguous-H1-open to four-hour close return divided by lagged H1 ATR24
method.event_definition: Daily classic S1/R1 nearest-pivot core d<0.20 with directional H1 wick >=30%; high-side signal is reversal-down, low-side signal is reversal-up; observed at H1 close.
method.overlap_rule: primary observation ledger retains all side-specific signals; deterministic four-hour same-side/group cooldown is reported as robustness only
method.unsafe_gap_rule: all forward bars must be contiguous UTC H1 bars; gaps make the affected endpoint missing

inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across nine primary phase-versus-non-transition comparisons

execution.spread_policy: structural midpoint study; executable BID/ASK not yet tested
execution.same_bar_policy: signal observable only after rejection H1 closes

holdout.prior_exposure: 2015-2025 had already been exposed in related pivot research. The time/session outcomes were frozen before inspection, but this is not represented as a pristine holdout confirmation.

provenance.notes: Hour 1/2/3 design and weekday variables were frozen before outcome inspection. Contiguous-H1 forward rule was clarified in a pre-outcome amendment.
